summary: End-to-end testing of 37Games AI Strategy Assistant. Backend pytest suite (16 tests) all passing including SSE streaming chat with Claude Sonnet 4.5 via Emergent Universal Key. Frontend Playwright flow covers landing, protected redirect, login, dashboard (10 game cards), all 4 game tabs (chat, optimizer, guides, tasks) including AI streaming response and AI optimizer (1476-char result).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~615 lines and mixes models, helpers, and routes — consider splitting into routers (auth, chat, tasks, builds, guides) and a separate db/models module for maintainability.

Chat history is replayed by stuffing prior 10 messages into the prompt text instead of using LlmChat's native multi-turn API. This works but inflates token usage and can hit context limits in long sessions; consider per-session LlmChat persistence or proper message-list API.
JWT_SECRET in backend/.env is the literal placeholder string 'change-me' — must be rotated to a strong secret in production.
CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True — this combo is invalid per CORS spec and unsafe for production. Restrict origins.
Optimizer endpoint always creates a new LlmChat instance per request (uuid session) — acceptable, but no rate limiting / abuse protection on AI-cost endpoints.
Streaming endpoint has no auth-error path for [error] tokens visible to client; UI may not differentiate model errors from content.
@app.on_event startup/shutdown are deprecated in newer FastAPI; prefer lifespan context manager.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 13 guides on startup. Tests used TEST_ prefixed users/tasks/builds and cleaned up created sessions/builds/tasks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers: root, games catalog (10 games incl. puzzles-conquest), auth (register/login/me + 401 paths), chat session CRUD, SSE streaming chat (content-type text/event-stream, data: chunks, terminates [DONE], persists user+assistant), AI optimizer, builds CRUD, guides (filtered + all 13), tasks CRUD (create/list/toggle/delete). Frontend tested via Playwright: landing data-testids, protected route redirect, login, 10 game cards on dashboard, 4 tabs (chat/optimizer/guides/tasks), guides list (3 for puzzles-conquest) + click, tasks add/toggle/delete, optimizer AI run (1476 chars), chat streaming with AI response visible in screenshot.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs found. One transient test log line 'FAIL: tab-chat not visible' is a test-script timing artifact (loop ran before tabs rendered); screenshot confirms chat tab fully functional with AI streaming reply.
